items.name: handleSetActiveUtilityAction
items.doc: Compare-and-sets a window's utility register and forwards the resolved utility to the owning program.

items.name: handleSetActiveToolAction
items.doc: Compare-and-sets the mode-level tool register, clears every window utility and forwards the tool to the program.

items.name: handleRecoveryAction
items.doc: Restarts or quarantines a program for the recovery controller actions.

items.name: handleWorldNavigationAction
items.doc: Completes the introduction interactions a camera navigation gesture report satisfies.

items.name: handleSyncCardAction
items.doc: Routes the sync card actions to the attach, detach, browse and selection callbacks.

items.name: handleSetActivePanelTabAction
items.doc: Validates and applies a panel tab activation on the host or the session program.

items.name: resolveDispatchTarget
items.doc: Resolves the spawned program that owns a dispatch from its controller and its window.

items.name: routeRemoteUndo
items.doc: Sends an undo to the mounted remote history owner when the undo route is remote.

items.name: buildDispatchViewState
items.doc: Builds the guest window id, the declared instances and the view state projection a dispatch carries.

items.name: dispatchDirectBrowserActorAction
items.doc: Runs an action through the hub-mounted browser actor and maps a rejection to a typed refusal.

items.name: dispatchProgramAction
items.doc: Runs an action through the program handler, applies its history patch and host effects and settles the ledger entry.
